title: Game Night 🎳
description: A casual night of games with YUnited — bowling, pool, and more, depending on where we end up. Come hang out, play a few rounds, and enjoy some downtime with the community. Details (venue and games) to be confirmed soon.

hr.title: Večer igara 🎳
